countries.reasoning: China is the world’s largest polyethylene producer with extensive petrochemical complexes; data based on recent industry and market reports from 2023 showing stable production levels.
The U.S. is the second largest producer; production data from American Chemistry Council and industry reports for 2023 confirm this figure with high reliability.
Saudi Arabia is a leading producer with major integrated petrochemical facilities; data from Saudi Aramco and industry publications in 2023.
South Korea has significant polyethylene production capacity; data from Korean Chemical Industry Association and recent trade data for 2023.
India's production has been growing; figures from Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers and trade data for 2023 with some reporting uncertainties.
